option_relations.rationale: Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma is a broader category that could include squamous cell carcinoma of the mediastinum if it is a metastasis from another site.
Secondary squamous cell carcinoma of the anterior mediastinum with unknown primary site is a type of squamous cell carcinoma of the mediastinum.
Thymic squamous cell carcinoma is a specific type of squamous cell carcinoma that can occur in the mediastinum.

Primary mediastinal squamous cell carcinoma is directly equivalent to squamous cell carcinoma of the mediastinum, as indicated by the biopsy results and imaging showing a mediastinal mass with squamous cell carcinoma features.
